title: Five cyclic fields with occupancy after exact noise-weight removals with exact signed parity shells

claims.statement: The explicit 5-field degree-200 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-47 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 55256097744492377/1000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=520434282060849179297297210055829264603965073201341387331621823415919264 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(238237/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact QR profiles, field, orbits and primitive bound (0), all ten averaged pair cutoffs with exact signed shell sums (1), exact child removal counts by noise weight (2), and full cumulative occupancy and error (3).
